name: titans-gate-ascension
description: Static GitHub Pages development platform and playable build for Titan Gates: Ascension.

scripts.build: npm run index && npm run validate && node scripts/build-pages.mjs
scripts.precommit:verify: npm run audit:continuity && npm run audit:aaa-structure && npm run validate:schemas && npm run test:production-modules && npm run validate:engine-adapters && npm run test:engine-adapters && npm run build && npm run index:check && npm run test:command-hub:stable && npm run test:playable-battle-ui && node scripts/visual-qa-smoke.mjs && npm run assets:verify && node scripts/validate-3d-blueprints.mjs && npm run test:solo-battle && npm run test:solo-vertical-slice && npm run test:battlefield-telemetry && npm run test:battlefield-runtime && npm run test:campaign-playflow && npm run test:async-arena && npm run test:creature-behavior && npm run validate:external-ai-packets && node scripts/secret-scan.mjs
scripts.test:command-hub:stable: npm run test:command-hub || npm run test:command-hub
scripts.assets:sync: npm run assets:detect && npm run assets:validate
scripts.assets:verify: npm run assets:sync && npm run assets:manifests && npm run assets:handoff && npm run assets:test-intake
scripts.artwork:finish: npm run artwork:queue && npm run artwork:import && npm run assets:verify
scripts.artwork:auto-import: npm run artwork:import && npm run build && npm run assets:verify && npm run index:check
